newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall for the third straight session in a row as a market correction persists, brokers said.
"The share prices are expected to fall further as the market is undergoing a correction following sharp rise over the past several sessions," said broker Khurshid Alam.

Brokers said a number of scrips in engineering, food, leather and cement sectors might fall on profit taking. DSE all-share price index closed 103.65 points, or 3.03 percent down, at 3,311.89 on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
